# ProcessInclusive

Auto-generated Ruby on Rails + Sidekiq project for BPMN process `Process_Inclusive` (Inclusive split and join).

## Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env
bundle install
bundle exec rspec
```

## Running with Sidekiq (HTTP Service Tasks)

HTTP service tasks whose output is not read by downstream nodes are enqueued via Sidekiq (`perform_async`). Make sure Redis is running and start both Rails and the Sidekiq worker:

```bash
redis-server
bundle exec sidekiq -C config/sidekiq.yml
bundle exec rails server
```

## Endpoint

- `GET /health`
- `POST /workflows/process_inclusive/execute`

class WorkflowsController < ApplicationController
  def health
    render json: { status: "ok", workflow: "Process_Inclusive" }
  end

  def execute
    payload = params.fetch(:payload, params.except(:controller, :action)).to_unsafe_h.to_hash
    result = Workflows::ProcessInclusiveWorkflow.call(payload)
    render json: result, status: :ok
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true
# Auto-generated by SHTLNG FlowSpec -> Ruby on Rails Compiler
# Process ID: Process_Inclusive (Inclusive split and join)

module Workflows
  class ProcessInclusiveWorkflow
    attr_reader :context, :visited_nodes, :enqueued_jobs

    MAX_STEPS = 100

    def self.call(initial_context = {})
      new(initial_context).call
    end

    def initialize(initial_context = {})
      @context = initial_context.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
      @visited_nodes = []
      @enqueued_jobs = []
      @join_arrivals = Hash.new(0)
    end

    def call
      queue = [:start_1]
      steps = 0

      while (current_node = queue.shift) && steps < MAX_STEPS
        steps += 1
        @visited_nodes << current_node.to_s
        next_nodes = dispatch_node(current_node)
        queue.concat(Array(next_nodes))
      end

      {
        completed: true,
        status: @enqueued_jobs.empty? ? "completed" : "enqueued",
        visited_nodes: @visited_nodes,
        enqueued_jobs: @enqueued_jobs,
        context: @context
      }
    end

    private

    def dispatch_node(node_id)
      case node_id
      when :start_1
        execute_start1
      when :task_1
        execute_task1
      when :inclusive_1
        execute_inclusive1
      when :task_2
        execute_task2
      when :task_3
        execute_task3
      when :task_4
        execute_task4
      when :task_5
        execute_task5
      when :inclusive_2
        execute_inclusive2
      when :end_1
        execute_end1
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "Unknown workflow node: #{node_id}"
      end
    end

    # [start] Start (start_1)
    def execute_start1
      [:task_1]
    end

    # [user_task] Choose channels (task_1)
    def execute_task1
      form = Forms::ChooseChannelsForm.new(@context.slice(:email, :sms))
      form.validate!
      [:inclusive_1]
    end

    # [inclusive_gateway] Which channels (inclusive_1)
    def execute_inclusive1
      active_branches = []
      active_branches << :task_2 if (@context[:email] == true)
      active_branches << :task_3 if (@context[:sms] == true)
      active_branches << :task_4
      active_branches << :task_5 if active_branches.empty?
      active_branches
    end

    # [service_task] Send email (task_2)
    def execute_task2
      [:inclusive_2]
    end

    # [service_task] Send SMS (task_3)
    def execute_task3
      [:inclusive_2]
    end

    # [service_task] Write log (task_4)
    def execute_task4
      [:inclusive_2]
    end

    # [service_task] Fallback (task_5)
    def execute_task5
      [:inclusive_2]
    end

    # [inclusive_gateway] Merge channels (inclusive_2)
    def execute_inclusive2
      active_branches = []
      active_branches << :end_1
      active_branches
    end

    # [end] Done (end_1)
    def execute_end1
      []
    end
  end
end

# The classes in these folders live in a namespace named after the folder
# (app/workflows -> Workflows::...). Without this, Rails expects top-level constants.
%w[Workflows Forms Jobs Services].each do |namespace_name|
  directory = Rails.root.join("app", namespace_name.downcase)
  next unless directory.directory?

  namespace = Object.const_set(namespace_name, Module.new)
  Rails.autoloaders.main.push_dir(directory, namespace: namespace)
end
